title: Professional Darts: PDC World Championship Rules, 501 Checkout Maths & Oche Etiquette
description: Specialized sports English module analyzing PDC tournament rules, 501 tactical checkout math, and oche throwing etiquette.
learning_objectives: Master professional darts terminology (oche, 501 double-out, checkout routes, bounce-outs)
Apply modal verbs and conditional structures to game rules and match strategy
Eliminate Czech interference errors when discussing scores, averages, and tournament play

questions.prompt: In professional 501 darts, a player _____ the leg by hitting a double or the 50-point red bullseye.

explanations.correct: Modal verb 'must' is followed directly by the bare infinitive 'finish' without 'to'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to' is ungrammatical; modal verbs never take 'to'.
explanations.wrong_D: 'must' cannot be followed by an '-ing' participle.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po způsobovém slovesu 'must' následuje vždy holý infinitiv bez 'to': 'must finish' (nikdy *must to finish*).

questions.prompt: If a player _____ a score of 40 remaining, the standard tactical route is throwing at double 20 (tops).

explanations.correct: First conditional if-clause requires Present Simple ('has') for real game scenarios.
explanations.wrong_A: Cannot use future modal 'will' inside an if-clause.
explanations.wrong_B: Cannot use 'would' in a real First Conditional.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense 'had' would create an unreal Second Conditional mismatched with present 'is throwing'.

questions.cz_learning_point: V podmínkové větě po 'if' se nesmí použít 'will' (*If a player will have*). Použijte přítomný čas: 'If a player has'.

questions.prompt: Tournament regulations mandate that players must stand strictly _____ the raised oche during every throw.

explanations.correct: Preposition 'behind' correctly describes the legal standing position relative to the oche throw-line.
explanations.wrong_B: 'into' denotes motion entering inside, not static position.
explanations.wrong_C: 'across to' expresses direction across a gap, not standing stance.
explanations.wrong_D: 'between of' is ungrammatical; 'between' does not take 'of'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Předložka 'behind' = za čárou (oche). Dejte pozor na chybnou vazbu *between of*.

questions.prompt: According to World Darts Federation specifications, match darts _____ 30.5 cm in total length.

explanations.correct: Negative modal 'must not' is followed by base form 'exceed' without 'to'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'exceed to' is ungrammatical; 'exceed' is transitive and takes a direct object.
explanations.wrong_B: 'are must' is completely ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Způsobové sloveso zákazu: 'must not exceed' (nesmí překročit). Sloveso 'exceed' se nepojí s předložkou 'to'.

questions.prompt: Sixteen-year-old Luke Littler _____ the PDC World Darts Championship final on his sensational debut in 2024.

explanations.correct: Specific completed past time 'in 2024' strictly requires Past Simple 'reached'.
explanations.wrong_A: Present Perfect 'has reached' cannot be used with a closed past date like 'in 2024'.
explanations.wrong_B: Present Simple expresses habitual routines, not a historic finished event.

questions.cz_learning_point: S konkrétním letopočtem v minulosti (in 2024) se v angličtině striktně pojí Past Simple ('reached'), nikoli předpřítomný čas.

questions.prompt: Michael van Gerwen switched to treble 19 with his third dart _____ he could set up a comfortable double 16.

explanations.correct: 'So that' is a conjunction of purpose followed by a subject and modal verb clause ('he could set up').
explanations.wrong_C: 'because of' is followed by a noun phrase, not a clause with a finite verb.

questions.cz_learning_point: Účelová spojka 'so that' = aby (následovaná celou větou: 'so that he could set up').

questions.prompt: If a dart strikes the steel spider wire and falls to the floor, it _____ as a bounce-out with zero score.

explanations.correct: Passive voice 'is recorded' correctly expresses how the dart is officially scored by the referee.
explanations.wrong_A: Active 'records' implies the dart records itself actively.
explanations.wrong_B: Present Continuous active does not fit the static rule definition.
explanations.wrong_C: Past tense 'recorded' conflicts with present conditional premise 'strikes'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Trpný rod u oficiálních pravidel: 'is recorded' (je započítána jako nula). Šipka se sama nezapisuje.

questions.prompt: Spectators and players alike _____ to remain silent while a competitor is on the oche addressing the board.

explanations.correct: Passive construction 'are expected' correctly conveys social and behavioral expectations.
explanations.wrong_B: Participle alone cannot form a finite predicate.
explanations.wrong_C: 'are expect' is an ungrammatical verb combination.
explanations.wrong_D: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modal 'must' does not take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vazba 'are expected to' = očekává se od nich, že... Častá chyba: *are expect* bez koncovky -ed.

questions.prompt: Hitting two maximum 180s followed by a 141 checkout _____ the ultimate achievement in modern darts.

explanations.correct: 'Must be' expresses logical deduction based on the rarity of a 9-dart finish.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modals never take 'to'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'can to be' is ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Logická dedukce (určitě je / musí být): 'must be'. Způsobová slovesa nepřibírají předložku 'to'.

questions.prompt: A player cannot claim the leg _____ their final dart lands securely in the required double segment.

explanations.correct: 'Unless' means 'except if' or 'if not', expressing the mandatory prerequisite for winning.
explanations.wrong_A: 'if' creates an illogical contradiction (cannot win IF it lands).
explanations.wrong_C: 'provided that' creates an illogical positive condition.
explanations.wrong_D: 'as long as' also creates an illogical condition.

questions.cz_learning_point: 'Unless' = pokud ne (if not). Po 'unless' už v angličtině nenásleduje další zápor: 'unless their final dart lands...'.
